name: Storepoint Store Locator
author: Storepoint

sections.description:
The official Storepoint Store Locator plugin for WordPress. Your customers search by zip code, city, or address, filter by category, and get directions. Your locator uses your brand colors, fonts, and style. Manage everything from one dashboard. Storepoint works on every website platform and this plugin brings the full experience to WordPress.

See live examples

Your locator, your brand

Your locator matches your website. Set your brand colors, fonts, and map theme from the dashboard. Upload custom map markers. Write your own CSS for pixel-perfect control. Or let our team style it for you with free brand matching on every plan.

Bring your locations

Add locations one at a time from the dashboard. Drag in a CSV spreadsheet to bulk import hundreds at once. Or connect a Google Sheet so your locator updates automatically when the spreadsheet changes. Search analytics show you where customers are looking.

Search, filter, find

Visitors search by address, city, zip code, or postcode with autocomplete suggestions. Filter results by product, category, service, or any custom tag. View opening hours with live open/closed status. Tap for one-click directions. Responsive on every screen size and translatable to any language.

Built for any industry

Retail brands with store locators. CPG companies with “where to buy” pages. Manufacturers managing dealer and distributor networks. Service businesses helping customers find providers, installers, contractors, or sales reps. Franchise directories. Healthcare with clinic and pharmacy finders. Restaurants, salons, and any business with locations customers need to find.

Start simple. Scale when ready.

Most locators are live in minutes. As your needs grow, Storepoint grows with you:

  • Territory management for dealer networks with catchment areas and service regions
  • Spotlight promotions to boost priority partners in search results
  • Online alternatives to show your website or online store when no nearby location exists
  • Custom fields and buttons for booking links, menus, social profiles, or any extra detail
  • Full CSS and JavaScript access for designers and developers
  • Three APIs for location management, search queries, and widget events (developer docs)

Works with everything

  • Gutenberg block with per-instance language, tag filter, and display settings
  • Shortcode for Classic Editor, Elementor, Divi, and WPBakery
  • Compatible with WPML and Polylang for multilingual WordPress sites
  • Google Maps or Mapbox as your map provider

Getting started

  1. Create your Storepoint account (7-day free trial, plans from $25/month)
  2. Add your locations and configure your map provider (Mapbox or Google Maps)
  3. Install this plugin, paste your token, and add the Storepoint block to any page

Third-Party Services

This plugin relies on the Storepoint hosted service (widget.storepoint.co, api.storepoint.co) to display your store locator. A Storepoint account is required.

  • Storepoint Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

Depending on your map provider, the locator also loads resources from Mapbox (api.mapbox.com) or Google Maps (maps.googleapis.com).
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for “Storepoint”
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate
  4. Go to Settings > Storepoint
  5. Paste your Public Locator Token (find it on your Embed page)
  6. Add the Storepoint Store Locator block to any page

Using the Shortcode

If you prefer shortcodes or use the Classic Editor:

[storepoint]

With options:

[storepoint tags="dealer,premium" language="auto" hide_filters="true"]
sections.faq:
How does pricing work?

The plugin is free to install. A Storepoint account is required to display your locator. Plans start at $25/month with a 7-day free trial. See pricing.

Do I need a Mapbox or Google Maps account?

Yes. Choose Mapbox or Google Maps as your map provider in the Storepoint dashboard. Both offer free tiers that cover most locators.

Can I use this as a dealer locator or stockist page?

Yes. Storepoint works as a store locator, dealer locator, stockist page, product locator, or any “where to buy” page. Add tags to your locations and use the pre-filter option to create category-specific locators on different pages.

Can I import locations from a spreadsheet?

Yes. Drag a CSV into the dashboard to bulk import. Or connect a Google Sheet for automatic sync. Changes in your spreadsheet update the locator automatically.

Does it work with WPML or Polylang?

Yes. Set the language to “Auto-detect from WordPress” in the block settings and the locator matches the current page language.

Does it work with Elementor, Divi, or WPBakery?

Yes. Use the [storepoint] shortcode in any HTML or code element within your page builder.

Can I use custom map markers?

Yes. Upload your own marker icons or use your brand colors. Show different markers for different location types or categories.

Where do I find my Public Locator Token?

Log in to your Storepoint dashboard and find the Public Token on the Embed page.

Where do I get support?

Email hello@storepoint.co or post in the WordPress.org support forum. We typically respond within one business day. You can also browse our tutorials and documentation.
